SELECT
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    1 AS QTYPUU_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0 as quantite_total,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0 as quantite_receptionne,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
  '{{ $json.num_facture }}' as numero_facture
FROM BASE1.PORDERQ O
INNER JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER A ON O.ITMREF_0 = A.ITMREF_0
WHERE O.POHNUM_0 = 'BC182974'
  AND O.ITMREF_0 = 'A15000'
GROUP BY
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0

SELECT
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    1 AS QTYPUU_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0 as quantite_total,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0 as quantite_receptionne,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    '{{ $json.num_facture }}' as numero_facture
FROM BASE1.PORDERQ O
INNER JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER A ON O.ITMREF_0 = A.ITMREF_0
WHERE O.POHNUM_0 = 'BC186532'
  AND O.ITMREF_0 = 'A15283'
GROUP BY
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0

SELECT
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    1 AS QTYPUU_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0 as quantite_total,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0 as quantite_receptionne,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    '{{ $json.num_facture }}' as numero_facture
FROM BASE1.PORDERQ O
INNER JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER A ON O.ITMREF_0 = A.ITMREF_0
WHERE O.POHNUM_0 = 'BC186553'
  AND O.ITMREF_0 = 'A15284'
GROUP BY
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0

SELECT CONCAT(XNAMSAL_0, ' ',XPRENOM_0 ) AS NOM_COMPLET
FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL
WHERE ZPOSTE_0 = 'PST00030' AND XFLG_0 = 2

select ITM.ITMREF_0,ITM.ITMDES1_0 from BASE1.ITMMASTER ITM
  inner join BASE1.PPRICLIST PRI on PRI.PLICRI1_0=ITM.ITMREF_0
where ITMREF_0='A15717'

SELECT
    '{{ $json.articles[0].designation }}' AS designation,
    '{{ $json.articles[0].montant }}'     AS montant,
    '{{ $json.numero_facture }}'          AS num_facture,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(p.XNFACT_0) > 0 THEN 'EXISTE' ELSE 'INEXISTANT' END AS status,
    COUNT(p.XNFACT_0)                     AS nb_lignes
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRECEIPT p
       ON p.XNFACT_0 = '{{ $json.numero_facture }}'

select DOCOR_0,MNT_0,BPCNAM_0 from  BASE1.XREGNLR
where BPCNUM_0='{{ $json.BPSNUM_0 }}'

SELECT
    '{{ $json.DOCOR_0 }}'  AS docor,
    '{{ $json.MNT_0 }}'    AS montant,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(p.XREFR_0) > 0 THEN 'EXISTE' ELSE 'INEXISTANT' END AS status,
    COUNT(p.XREFR_0)       AS nb_lignes
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRECEIPT p
       ON p.XREFR_0 = '{{ $json.DOCOR_0 }}'
      AND p.XMNT_0  = {{ $json.MNT_0 }}
